name: Reconnecting
detailed_description:
THE STORY

WARNING 18+: Kelly's mother gave her up for adoption 24 years ago, despite your protests a a very close friend who would help out a lot and would takeover when Kelly’s mother didn’t feel like being one. You really bonded with the young girl despite not being her father, so you decide to reach out now as a 40-year-old man after hesitating for so many years. You actually hit it off better than you imagine. As a matter of fact, you hit it off so well you soon start a romantic relationship. The problem is both of you are married and have to navigate your new, budding relationship in secret while balancing life.

THE GAME PLAY

In Reconnecting, you play as the main character and take control of all the decision-making, such as responding in a more understanding or strict way. You have control of how you play, though this visual novel has linear elements and some story elements are out of your hands, and established in the story!

***A free in-game walkthrough is also included for those who have trouble with selecting the correct choices, or for players who want to access every scene!***

FEATURES

- Name your own character

- Define the relationship within the game

- Select some choices that shape the story

- Replay the game and choose different choices to access all content
